A gas station caught fire during the event as a result of a grenade injuring several civilians nearby. Security forces had clashed with the elements the day prior (coded as a separate event).

The man was wanted for his alleged involvement in a 2015 mosque bombing in Abha. The Saudi authorities did not disclose whether he was associated with any specific armed group.

Interception: On 25 June 2019, Saudi coalition forces announced that they had shot down a Houthi drone over the city of Khamis Mushait on the 25 June, 2019, with no injuries reported.
